remarks: This unit needs to be seen in person to fully appreciate an ample space it offers. All updated and polished spacious 2-story rental with a mud room at the entrance and plenty of space in the finished lower level. The unit comes with a huge deck overlooking a beautifully landscaped park-like backyard. Gorgeous new beach with swimming pools and tennis courts is only a short walking distance from the house. And it all could be yours! Ask for a private showing before this beautiful place is gone and spend summer months playing tennis, basking under the sun and swimming on the beach.
